newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SIX CIRCUMCISION INITIATES DIE IN S.AFRICAN BLAZE.
newsitem.headline: SIX CIRCUMCISION INITIATES DIE IN S.AFRICAN BLAZE.

text.p: Six circumcision initiates were killed and nine others seriously injured on Friday in a blaze which destroyed their hut in a rural South African region.

Police in Umtata, centre of the former Transkei black homeland now incorporated into the Eastern Cape region, told state radio that the fire spread very quickly, gutting the hut in the Mount Frere district.
The injured initiates were rushed to the Mary Theresa Hospital at Mount Frere for treatment. The names of the dead youths are being withheld until their families are notified.
The cause of the fire has not been established yet.
Circumcision to signify manhood among male youths is a widely practised ritual of the region's Xhosa tribe, to which President Nelson Mandela also belongs.
